author: kycrafft
body:
(Dammit he has ideas again? Thought that stopped in Old Avicus...)

Handyman (or Ballzi the Builder): Wood sword, axe, shovel and pick, all with efficiency 1(not sword) and unbreaking
Abilities: None
Level: 6-10
Description: A useful kit for low level players, for it makes getting early game resources quick and easy.

Dragon: Bow with flame 1 and 20 durability named "Dragon's Breath", 10 arrows
Abilities: When holding the bow, it gives you -30% speed (or slowness 2, same thing)
Level: 14-19
Description: Unquie kit as it allows the player to attack with flame. The bow can give a very strategic advantage, but the kit is limited by slowness, bow durability and lack of other abilities.

Ninja: 3 shurikens (do about 2 hearts to somone without armor), 3 enderpearls
Abilities: none
Level: 21-24
Description: It's decent mobility kit, characterised by the enderpearls, but can also deal some mediocre damage when using shurikens correctly. Be careful, as if you use up all the items, the kit is pretty much useless.

Soldier: 3 iron, paper explaining kill rewards
Abilities: each kill will give you 2 iron, a golden apple, 3 xp bottles and 16 arrows. These are dropped at your feet if there is no room in your inventory
Level: 25-29
Description: This kit is purely an offensive kit as that is how you earn items. The itmes you earn my seem small but can make a difference when they start adding up.

Hunter: sharp 1 diamond sword, 2 golden apples
Abilities: infinite speed 
Level: 29-36
Description: Another offensive kit. Grab your sword and hunt others down

Wizard: leather chestplate named "magic chestplate" with unbreaking 10 and projectile protection 2
Abilities: Wearing the chestplate gives you a ton of potion effects of an infinite amount of time. Taking off the chestplate, however removes them all until you put it back on. These effects are speed 1, regen 1, resistance 1, haste 1, night vision, water breathing, fire resistance, jump boost 2 and hunger 1.
Level: 42-45
Description: If used right, this kit can dominate. A wide range of effects can make the user ready for anything. However, you are limited by the gold chestplate and the hunger 1. Never under estimate that god damn hunger effect.

replies.body: Wizard and Hunter are incredibly OP.  I like all the others aside from that. Put only a few status (1-3) effects on Wizard and it would be fine, also Hunter should get one golden apple.

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body:
How is hunter that op? It has a diamond sword wi sharp 1 (80% of players have those when the walls fall), speed and some golden apples. If you want to nerf hunted by taking away apples, my question is "what makes apples so powerful?"

I think I could nerf wizard down to a leather chestplate or something. But just remember that running around with constant hunger means you can't run or catch someone without have to constantly eat

replies.author: Iron
replies.body: Ky, in the midst of a battle you might get a quick break which allows you to chug an apple. This is actually fight changing believe it or not. Those extra few hearts can be the difference between life or death. Also Dia Swords with Sharp 1 are WAYYYYY TO OP.  Diamond Swords combined with eternal Speed is just a no no..
